title: Normalize an inventory ledger
summary: Normalize SKU casing, merge duplicate rows, and return deterministic tags without changing the caller's data.
objectives: Normalize SKUs with trimming and uppercasing while validating empty values.
Merge duplicate SKUs and union normalized tags without mutating the caller's data.
Return deterministic ordering with non-nil empty slices.
constraints: Keep the public Item type, ErrInvalidSKU sentinel, and NormalizeInventory signature.
Validate the trimmed SKU before discarding a non-positive quantity.
Never modify the input slice, its items, or any Tags backing array.
Return a non-nil empty slice for an item with no tags and for an empty result.
Sort the result by SKU and each item's tags ascending.
Deduplicate tags after trimming and discard empty tags.

examples.input: items = [{SKU: " b ", Quantity: 2, Tags: [" x ", "x"]}, {SKU: "a", Quantity: 1, Tags: []}]
examples.explanation: SKUs are trimmed and uppercased, rows are ordered by SKU, and duplicate tags are removed.

examples.input: items = [{SKU: "a", Quantity: 2, Tags: ["z"]}, {SKU: " A ", Quantity: 5, Tags: ["a", "z"]}]
examples.explanation: Duplicate SKUs keep the highest quantity and union their tags.
A SKU that is empty after trimming rejects the whole call.

public.name: Normalize and order
public.description: Trimmed SKUs are uppercased, non-positive rows are dropped, and the result is sorted.

public.name: Merge duplicate SKUs
public.description: Duplicate SKUs keep the highest quantity and union their tags.

hidden.name: Input immutability
